metadata.description: A router/worker setup for Claude Code: one router session hands tickets to workers in their own git worktrees, checks their results and delivers each batch as one PR.

plugins.name: superagent
plugins.description: Installs and upgrades the router/worker setup in a project with one interactive command, /superagent:setup.

plugins.name: superagent-board
plugins.description: A live pane for the router's session: tickets, running agents, watchdog alerts and a dot map of every agent.
